scanner: opcode-valid RIP-relative scanner (48/4c 8d/8b/89/63, 8d/8b/89, 0f b6/b7/6f/7e/10/11, f2 0f 10/11, 48 0f b6/b7, ff 15/25, 48 c7 05, c7 05) over .text + ctr
note: instruction boundaries are NOT verified by the scanner (byte pattern may match mid-instruction), so all counts are upper bounds.  The identifiers referenced from code are module names, protobuf/JSON field names and generic words - the game member names (health, teamId, ...) are NOT referenced from code and are NOT present as plain strings in .rdata.

member_name_absence.question: do the wanted member names (Health, TeamId, SquadId, ...) exist in bf6.exe together with their offsets?

classification.what_those_other_functions_are: JSON/protobuf serializers (0x10c7420 LEA '"', 'type', '":', '}'), string getters (`lea rax,[rip+str]; ret`) and type-name users such as 0x16b0110 / 0x118e600 which build a 'LocalPlayer' / 'Health' string

member_name_absence.verdict: the names that exist are TYPE names (TeamId, Health, ClientPlayer, LocalPlayer, ClientPlayerManager, HealthComponent, ...); every code reference to them is a type-registration stub or a type-name user, and no field/member registration code exists.  There is NO name+offset table anywhere in the file.

name_cell_table.cell: {u64 name ptr, 24 zero bytes} (some cells carry u32 1 at +0x10)
name_cell_table.contents: UI property names (SquadId, TeamId, LobbySquad, LobbyTeam, PersonaId, ReturnValue, SquadLimitsOut, SlotIndex, ...)

ui_property_region.note: the first occurrence of Health/TeamId/SquadId/PersonaId/SlotIndex/LocalPlayer sits in the BFUI property area - UI bindings, not the gameplay reflection

type_name_pool.content: type names, template instantiations and nested names (ClientPlayerManager, ClientPlayerManager.IdleState, NativePtr<ClientPlayerExtent>, ClientCharacterEntityGhost, ...)
type_name_pool.name_xrefs: every code reference is a registration stub that also writes a typeinfo node

module_table_RIFXRIFF.record: {u64 module name ptr, u64[4]=0, u64 count, u64 header{u32 size,u32 count}, per type: {u64 type name, u64 super type name, u64 .text fn x3}}

related_outputs.p2_key_stores.json: non-registration-stub stores into the typeinfo section (function RVA + instruction + target bytes)
